name: sim_caretaker_calls_waves_in_a_race
description: The caretaker races (contract-m6 4): in Tide Race it plays its seat on its own team's hollow and, once its window's build steps are done (the next step waits for gold), says Ready, so a hollow it plays alone calls its wave at once and is paid the early gold, while the rival's window counts on. A plan step marked "ready": false holds that: waiting on it, the caretaker waits out the window. Beside a player its seat counts as Ready, and the horn is the player's call. In High Water a hollow every seat of which is caretaken still waits out its windows (sim_all_caretaken_waits_out_windows).

steps.assert: m.seat(2).hollow == 1 and scene.tower_on(1, 8, 11) != null and scene.tower_on(1, 8, 11).owner == 2 and scene.owner_at(8, 11) == 0
steps.msg: the caretaker builds its plan on its own hollow
its builds done, it said Ready at tick 0 and its hollow's horn sounded
with the early gold; the player's hollow is still in its window

steps.assert: scene.forms(2) == ['arrow', 'arrow'] and m2.seat(2).plan_cursor == 2 and not m2.seat(2).ready and m2.hollows[1].phase == 0
steps.msg: waiting on a step that holds Ready, it does not call the wave
it waits out its window, as the player beside it does
team B, two caretakers, called its wave; team A's caretaker is Ready, but the horn waits for its player
